cohort_scope.prior_dcs_scope: One participant reported DCS on an earlier separate chamber occasion. The earlier visit is unlinked.

cohort_scope.oxygen_note: Nominal oxygen breathing started on ascent. The participants lay left-side recumbent throughout.
